dedupe_keys.name: otc permanent gnss station network of tunisia

description: The Tunisian Office of Topography and Cadastre runs a network of permanent GNSS stations. Its GNSS page says the office installed three permanent GPS stations in Tunis, Monastir and Sfax from 2005 and, after adopting the new Tunisian triangulation (NTT) in 2009, twenty more stations in 2010 across the country except the Saharan part, giving 23 permanent stations tied to WGS84 and ITRF 2000. Each station has a weather station for temperature, pressure and humidity, a GSM modem, a UHF radio and a tilt meter, and the office manages the network centrally, collecting data and providing a network RTK service. Subscriptions are sold to the office's own districts, private surveyors and public bodies, named as the agricultural land agency, SONEDE (water), STEG (electricity and gas), ONAS (sanitation) and Telecom; enquiries go to the commercial directorate. Access is by paid subscription; no licence is stated. Caveats: the page gives no station list or data archive, the network excludes the Saharan south, and the reference frame given is ITRF 2000. Coverage is northern and central Tunisia. It supports studies of positioning infrastructure used by utilities and of space weather effects on GNSS; related records are the ANCFCC permanent GNSS network of Morocco and SENCORS of Senegal.
